lines.act3.assets.petition#17: Man Shi carried the record boxes for me because I asked him to, and nobody ever has. He is a head taller than the room and has no idea of it. Useful, and not in the way people assume.
lines.act3.assets.witnesses#7: Went looking for men who remember the original arrangement. Three do. Two want money. One wants my uncle embarrassed, which is cheaper.
lines.act3.assets.witnesses#8: Three people remember the arrangement. Two would like to be paid to remember it; the third would rather not be asked.
lines.act3.assets.witnesses#12: Paid the two. Recorded the amount, because the point of this ledger is that I never pretend a victory was free.
lines.act3.assets.witnesses#14: My aunt came to the tavern to explain to the room that I am ungrateful. She is good at it. I let her finish, and then asked her quietly which year the transfer was recorded in.
lines.act3.assets.witnesses#16: She did not know. Neither does he. A household that cannot date its own paperwork loses to a household that can.
lines.act3.assets.council#8: The council heard it. My uncle spoke first and spoke too long, which is what a man does when his case is a feeling.
lines.act3.assets.council#12: Elder Bo asked for the dates. I gave the dates. There is a particular silence a council makes when the tedious party turns out to be the correct one.
lines.act3.assets.council#14: Adjourned for consideration. Consideration means the elders are counting who owes what to whom. Nobody is owed anything by me, and in this instance that works in my favour.
lines.act3.assets.council#16: Used the adjournment to settle the two witnesses properly and to leave my uncle entirely alone. A man with nothing to push against looks like a man with nothing.
lines.act3.assets.settlement#7: Found in my favour. The property, the tavern, the leaf terraces and the accounts, transferred on a recorded date nobody can argue with.
lines.act3.assets.settlement#8: The property, the tavern, the terraces and the accounts, transferred in one afternoon and signed in front of the family.
lines.act3.assets.settlement#12: My uncle asked whether family means anything to me. I told him it means a recorded transfer date. That is the only form of it that has ever protected anybody in this clan.
lines.act3.assets.settlement#14: Took possession. Fang Zheng was in the room and said he hoped this would let us be brothers again. He believed it. I have stopped finding that useful and begun finding it inconvenient.
lines.act3.bai.interlude#7: Word from the Bai clan reached the village before the Bai did. A clan that keeps its own accounts and settles them late. Someone there holds a grievance against their own house, and a grievance is a handle.
lines.act3.bai.interlude#8: Word from the Bai reaches the village a full day before the Bai do. The clan that keeps its own accounts is in no hurry.
lines.act3.leaves.nine-leaf#6: Nine Leaf Vitality Grass. It grows leaves on a cycle, and a leaf restores vitality. The only healing I own and the only income I can predict.
lines.act3.leaves.nine-leaf#7: Nine leaves on a stem that grows them back. Cut one and the vitality comes with it. Cut all nine and there is nothing left to come back to.
lines.act3.leaves.nine-leaf#11: Jiang Ya buys the leaves at five stones and does not ask where the terraces came from. Prices first, pleasantries afterward. My preferred kind of merchant.
lines.act3.moonglow.failure#5: Attempted Moonglow. The refinement did not take. Lost the materials and the better part of a week.
lines.act3.moonglow.failure#6: The refinement does not take. The materials are gone, the week is gone, and the recipe on the bench is unchanged and still correct.
lines.act3.moonglow.failure#8: Went back over the recipe. The error was not in the recipe. Some refinements fail because refinement is uncertain, and an instructor who tells students otherwise is managing their morale, not teaching them.
lines.act3.moonglow.failure#10: Bought the materials again out of leaf income. The failure cost eleven stones and nine days, and it did not cost me Moonlight Gu. That is the only part of the sentence that mattered.
lines.act3.moonglow.success#5: Second attempt. Slower, colder, every measure taken twice, because the first failure was not a fault in the recipe and I had nothing else to change.
lines.act3.moonglow.success#7: Moonglow Gu. Rank two, at range, and it replaces the crescent as the thing I actually fight with.
lines.act3.moonglow.success#9: Put the Moonblade back to practice. Kept feeding Moonlight Gu regardless. A Gu you stop feeding is a Gu you no longer own, and I do not give things away on the assumption I will never need them.
lines.act3.tavern.property#7: The tavern has a wage bill, a supplier, a loss on the stock and a landlord, and from this month the landlord is me. The arithmetic is the arithmetic of the aperture: income, upkeep, what is left.
lines.act3.tavern.property#8: Two floors, a wage bill, a supplier who is owed, and Man Shi in the doorway deciding whether the new landlord is a problem.
lines.act3.tavern.property#12: Traded for a Black Boar Gu and kept the strength after the trade went through. Strength that survives the sale of its source is the nearest thing to free money on this mountain.
lines.act3.tavern.property#14: Man Shi broke a table and then repaired it badly. Put him on the door instead. A troublemaker pointed outward is a fixture.
lines.act3.four-flavours.refinement#5: Four Flavours needs a second Liquor worm. Bought one. So I have spent real money to destroy a Gu I paid for, in order to make a Gu that eats more than both of them did.
lines.act3.four-flavours.refinement#6: A second Liquor worm, bought at full price, to be spent making the first one permanent.
lines.act3.four-flavours.refinement#8: Three days checking the recipe against two sources before touching the materials. The last failure taught me what nine days cost.
lines.act3.four-flavours.refinement#10: Refined it, and it took. Two sources, three days of checking, and a steadier hand than I had in the spring.
lines.act3.four-flavours.refinement#12: Four Flavours Liquor worm. It raises Rank two essence by a small stage, and it drinks six stones of wine every four days. My income now has one duty, and the duty is feeding a worm.
lines.act3.stealth-scales#6: Bought Stealth Scales off the medicine hall's back shelf. Ordinary wolves lose track of whatever wears it.
lines.act3.stealth-scales#10: And Earth Communication Ear Grass, which marks what is moving through the ground. Together they cost nineteen stones, and they are why I expect to see the spring.
lines.act3.stealth-scales#12: Tested both on the lower slopes. The concealment holds while I walk and fails the moment I fight. Recorded, because that failure is the whole shape of this winter.
lines.act3.wolf-tide.warnings#7: The tide is coming. Nobody argues with a season; they argue about the roster, which is how a village spends the last quiet week it will get.
lines.act3.wolf-tide.warnings#8: The season is not in dispute. The roster is, which is how a village argues about a thing it cannot argue with.
lines.act3.wolf-tide.warnings#12: Qing Shu has the forward position. He is old, he is scarred, and he asked for equipment rather than honour, which is how I know he understands the order he was given.
lines.act3.wolf-tide.warnings#14: The village is fortifying. I bought water shield stock instead of helping, and the distance between those two acts is the distance between me and Qing Shu.
lines.act3.wolf-tide.warnings#16: Water Shield Gu, recorded and stored. White Jade stays equipped. Redundancy is cheap when it is bought before it is needed.
lines.act3.wolf-tide.forest#6: Into the forest. Lightning wolves, and not one kind of them. The small fast ones drive; the heavy ones arrive behind. The pack is a structure, not a crowd.
lines.act3.wolf-tide.forest#7: The small fast ones come first and drive. The heavy ones come after, along the line the first ones opened.
lines.act3.wolf-tide.forest#9: Concealed, and moved. Two hours of crossing instead of twenty minutes of fighting, and I finished with essence still in hand.
lines.act3.wolf-tide.forest#11: Fought once, because a ravine left me no choice. Spent a third of the sea on four wolves. That exchange is the whole argument for never fighting.
lines.act3.wolf-tide.forest#13: Listened through the soil at the ridge and counted what was behind the first wave. There is no position on this mountain that holds against that number. Qing Shu's included.
lines.act3.qing-shu.last-stand#6: Found his position from above. He had arranged it properly: lines, reliefs, a place to fall back to. It was competent, and it was not going to be enough, and both of those were plain from where I stood.
lines.act3.qing-shu.last-stand#7: From above the position reads well: lines, reliefs, a fallback. It was arranged by a man who expected to be relieved.
lines.act3.qing-shu.last-stand#11: Watched. I will not dress that word up. I was concealed, I had leaves, and I had the essence to go down, and I chose the ridge.
lines.act3.qing-shu.last-stand#13: It fell at dusk. He was organising a relief that no longer existed when it stopped. I came down the far side of the ridge and reached the village with everybody else.
lines.act3.qing-shu.last-stand#14: Nothing about that day requires explaining, and nobody has asked me to explain it.
lines.act3.aftermath.tally#4: The tally: the forward position gone, the second line holding, a third of the forest burnt. The village will talk about Qing Shu for twenty years, and it will talk about him accurately.
lines.act3.aftermath.tally#6: Leaf prices doubled. The wounded need vitality and there is one supply of it on this mountain. I did not raise my price. A man who gouges during a disaster is a man people remember clearly.
lines.act3.aftermath.tally#8: The tavern was full every night for a week. Grief drinks. Took the money and said the right things to the right men at the right volume.
lines.act3.aftermath.tally#10: Closed the season's accounts. Four hundred and sixty stones, after upkeep. I have never held this much, and I have never been this close to needing to leave.
lines.act3.yao-le.encounter#6: Met a Yao girl in the forest past the second ridge. Soaked through, frightened, and visibly relieved to see a face from the village. She said my name as though it were good news.
lines.act3.yao-le.encounter#7: Past the second ridge, soaked through, and visibly relieved to see anyone at all.
lines.act4.yao-le.rank-three#6: What I needed was in front of me, and it had a name, and it was glad to see me. I am not going to set the rest of it down here. This ledger records cost, and the cost was a person who trusted the wrong face.
lines.act4.yao-le.rank-three#7: The ritual runs the whole night. What comes out of it is Rank three, and three things left in the world that were not there yesterday.
lines.act4.yao-le.rank-three#11: Rank three. White silver. Genuine, and anyone may verify it. The clan will examine the result long before it examines the road to it. The site is three things now: a place, an absence, and a last-seen.
lines.act4.council.elder#8: The council acknowledged the rank. Chi Lian spoke in favour as though we had an understanding of long standing. We do not, and it is now in both our interests to let that stand.
lines.act4.council.elder#9: The rank is acknowledged, and Chi Lian speaks in favour as though an understanding existed. In the village, a Yao woman is asking after someone.
lines.act4.council.elder#13: An elder at fifteen. Every smile in that hall was a real gesture of power, and not one of them was trust. Yao Ji was outside it, asking people about her sister.
lines.act4.forge.elder-tools#5: An elder may requisition what a student could only look at. Sky Canopy for defence, Thunderwings for distance. Sky Canopy replaces White Jade. Thunderwings is the first thing I have owned that makes leaving a plan rather than a wish.
lines.act4.forge.elder-tools#6: Requisitioned, not bought. The list an elder may draw on is longer, and every line of it eats more than the last.
lines.act4.forge.blood-moon#6: Went through the clan's Rank three recipes. Most of them tie the holder to clan supply through the diet. Convenient, for the clan.
lines.act4.forge.blood-moon#7: Most of the clan's Rank three recipes feed on something only the clan sells. This one does not.
lines.act4.forge.blood-moon#9: Chose Blood Moon and refined it without error. A red crescent, with a second strike that lands late. Its diet is blood, and there is blood anywhere there are animals, which is everywhere I am going.
lines.act4.medicine.order#6: Chi Zhong has inherited the medical administration and is pressing an order his predecessor could not enforce. He is young for the post and he quotes regulations at men who outrank him.
lines.act4.medicine.order#10: Complied with the order, publicly, at a small cost. A new elder who fights the first requisition is a new elder somebody starts a file on.
lines.act4.village.search#7: Yao Ji has asked the same question, in the same words, for five weeks. The village has begun avoiding her. That helps me and it costs her.
lines.act4.village.search#8: Five weeks of the same question in the same words. The village has stopped finding it strange, which is its own kind of danger.
lines.act4.village.search#12: Walked the route back, to see what I had left behind. A path used more than it should be, and two people who can date the afternoon.
lines.act4.village.search#14: Cleaned what could be cleaned. Two stones to a carter with a poor memory, and a better one afterward. The third item cannot be cleaned, only contradicted, and a contradiction needs a second story to lean on.
lines.act4.village.search#16: Built the second story out of three true facts and one arrangement of them. That is the strongest kind, and the kind that survives an investigator.
lines.act4.centipede.equip#5: Added the Chainsaw Golden Centipede. Close range, expensive for every swing. I do not intend to use it, and I intend very much to have it.
lines.act4.centipede.equip#7: Practised with it away from the village. Everything I equip now is chosen for a road and not for a clan.
lines.act4.centipede.equip#9: Priced the upkeep of everything I carry at Rank three. Roughly four times what it was in winter. An elder's standing is a thing that must be fed, daily, like any Gu.
lines.act4.supplies.tusita#6: Requisitioned travelling supplies through the medicine hall on a legitimate order. Chi Zhong signed it because the paperwork was correct.
lines.act4.supplies.tusita#7: Travelling supplies, requisitioned on a legitimate order, signed by a man who checked the paperwork and not the reason.
lines.act4.supplies.tusita#11: Tusita Flower. Storage, and the reason a departure can be packed in advance with no one ever seeing luggage.
lines.act4.supplies.tusita#13: Packed. Long before I will need it. Nobody in this village would believe how many years I have been leaving.
lines.act4.investigation.arrival#9: Tie Ruo Nan has arrived. Travelling clothes, a notebook, and the unhurried attention of someone who expects to be lied to and is not offended by it.
lines.act4.investigation.arrival#10: Travelling clothes, a notebook, and the unhurried attention of someone who expects to be lied to and has planned for it.
lines.act4.investigation.arrival#14: She did not open with Yao Le. She opened with Jia Jin Sheng, which means she read the old inquiry before she came, which means she is better than Jia Fu was.
lines.act4.investigation.arrival#16: Gave her the fossil account and the dates. She wrote both down and asked me to repeat one detail. I repeated it identically, which is what a true account does, and also what a rehearsed one does.
lines.act4.investigation.arrival#18: She is going to walk the places. I have known that since the first inquiry opened, and I have spent two years making the places dull.
lines.act4.investigation.trail#7: She went up the bamboo path. There is a trail there that no longer leads anywhere interesting, and it took four separate afternoons across two years to make that true.
lines.act4.investigation.trail#8: She walks the bamboo path at the hour it happened, and stops where the ground is wrong.
lines.act4.investigation.trail#12: She asked the carter. He told her about a cart, a junction, and nothing else, because that is now all he has.
lines.act4.investigation.trail#14: She asked why a Rank one student's essence readings from two winters ago do not match a Rank two's. Nobody else has asked that question in two years. I had an answer ready, and I did not enjoy using it.
lines.act4.investigation.trail#16: Tie Xue Leng is with her now. He has asked me nothing. He watches, and when he speaks it will be a conclusion and not a question.
lines.act4.investigation.theory#8: She has a theory. It is coherent, it fits most of the evidence, and it is wrong, and it is wrong in a direction she chose herself.
lines.act4.investigation.theory#9: The theory is coherent. It fits most of the evidence, and it is wrong, and it is wrong in the direction that lets her leave.
lines.act4.investigation.theory#13: It is wrong because of the two pieces I removed and the one I arranged. Had I left the first of them in place it would be right, and I would be finished.
lines.act4.investigation.theory#15: She put her theory to the council. They accepted it. Jia Fu did not, and Jia Fu has neither standing nor evidence, and has had neither since the day his inquiry closed.
lines.act4.investigation.theory#17: Closed. I have recorded the exact margin by which this did not go the other way, because I intend to remember it as a near miss and not as a talent.
lines.act4.deep-inheritance.founder#7: There is something beneath the clan. Not a vault. A purpose. I went down because the alternative was waiting for it to come up.
lines.act4.deep-inheritance.founder#8: The chamber goes back further than the light. Whatever this was cut for, it was not cut for anyone standing in it now.
lines.act4.deep-inheritance.founder#12: The chamber is larger than any room on this mountain, and it was not built for the living. Whoever laid out the Gu Yue clan was not laying out a clan.
lines.act4.deep-inheritance.founder#14: Took the Heavenly Essence Treasure Lotus. Nothing stopped me. That is the part that concerns me.
lines.act4.deep-inheritance.founder#16: The founder is down here, and he has been down here the whole time. The clan has spent three hundred years celebrating a story about a man who is lying under its floor.
lines.act4.blood-lake.stone-aperture#6: Lord Sky Crane has come over the mountain out of Central Continent, carrying a grudge older than anyone now standing on it. The clan is furniture to him.
lines.act4.blood-lake.stone-aperture#7: The lake does not move. What it offers is taken once, and there is nothing behind it.
lines.act4.blood-lake.stone-aperture#11: Used the Stone Aperture Gu. Rank three peak inside a quarter of an hour, in a chamber built to make exactly that offer.
lines.act4.blood-lake.stone-aperture#13: It is spent, and with it any chance of anything above this rank. I traded my ceiling for my survival, and I would trade it again, and I am writing it down as a loss because that is what it is.
lines.act4.blood-lake.stone-aperture#15: The blood lake is not a lake. Stood at the edge of it and understood at last what the founder's history had been advertising.
lines.act4.founder.sky-crane#9: The two of them began, and the scale of it put every fight I have had on this mountain in its proper place. Duels, examinations, wolves. Training.
lines.act4.founder.sky-crane#10: The two of them begin, and every fight on this mountain is put in its place at once.
lines.act4.founder.sky-crane#14: Kept to the edges. There is no version of that fight in which I am a participant and a version in which I am a survivor. Only one of the two is on offer.
lines.act4.founder.sky-crane#16: Bai Ning Bing came down into it. I did not arrange that and I did not prevent it. There is a difference between the two, and nobody down there was keeping score.
lines.act4.founder.sky-crane#18: Fang Zheng was carried off toward Central Continent, unconscious and alive. Alive is the part that will cost somebody later. I record where he went so that I do not forget it.
lines.act4.blood-curtain.decision#7: The curtain went up over the mountain. I will record the decision and not the arithmetic beneath it, because the arithmetic does not improve on a second reading.
lines.act4.blood-curtain.decision#8: The curtain goes up over the mountain, red from below and silent. Afterwards there is the sound of the village, and then there is not.
lines.act4.blood-curtain.decision#12: It went wrong. Badly, and in a way I had not priced, and that is the first time in two lives I can write that sentence honestly.
lines.act4.blood-curtain.decision#14: Used the Cicada. The second time in two lives, and the last one I have, spent on a mountain I was already finished with.
lines.act4.blood-curtain.decision#16: Spring, then autumn, and a short way backward. Knowing exactly what is coming is not the same as being able to stop it, and the second time through I did not try to stop all of it.
lines.act4.blood-curtain.cicada#6: Out across the glacier, with the mountain behind me doing what mountains do when something that old is finished with them. I did not look back, and not for any reason worth recording.
lines.act4.blood-curtain.cicada#7: Out across the glacier, with the mountain behind him doing what mountains do when something that large is spent on them.
lines.act4.bai.transformation#7: Gave Bai the Yin Gu. The arm is back, and something else is different, and we both watched it happen without discussing it. I kept Yang. That is not an oversight, and Bai knows it is not an oversight.
lines.act4.bai.transformation#8: The arm comes back, and something else goes with it. They both watch it happen, and neither says what it was.
lines.act4.escape.raft#7: A raft on the Yellow Dragon River. Rank one, no healing Gu, one companion I hold through a Gu I did not give away, and the Southern Border ahead. Qing Mao is finished.
lines.act4.escape.raft#8: I have been here before. Not this river, but this position, and last time it took five hundred years. I know a number of things now that I did not know then.
lines.act4.escape.raft#9: A raft on the Yellow Dragon River. Rank one, no healing Gu, and the Southern Border somewhere past the next bend.

ledger.1: Eight of them, and none willing to be the first through the door. I spent what I had left making the arithmetic clear to them. When the accounting no longer favoured me I reached for the Cicada, which is the one thing in five hundred years I never spent.
ledger.2: Spring, then autumn. The sum of a life drawn back to its opening balance. I did not feel it as mercy; I felt it as a ledger closed and reopened on the first page.
ledger.3: Rain on the bamboo. Fifteen years old, a thin blanket, an aperture that does not exist yet, and twelve primeval stones to my name. The room is exactly as I remember it, which means everything in it is already accounted for.
ledger.4: The Hope Gu gathered and the aperture opened. Forty-four percent. The elder read it out the way a clerk reads a figure he has read ten thousand times, and the crowd agreed with him.
ledger.5: My brother's grade was read second, and the hall behaved as though a verdict had been handed down on both of us. A grade, one hundred percent. He will be funded. I will be tolerated. Both of those are useful to know precisely.
ledger.6: Walked the mountain afterward to put distances back in my legs. Spear bamboo, straight and sharpened at the tip, exactly where it stood five centuries ago. The landscape is the only thing here that has not changed its mind about me.
ledger.7: Took Moonlight Gu from the Gu room. A pale crescent, cold as jade, and the clan's signature because the clan owns the method of breeding it. Convenient for them. The first thing I learned about it is what it eats.
ledger.8: Two primeval stones for a jar of Green Bamboo Wine. Out of twelve that is a sixth of everything I have, spent on a smell. Anyone watching would call it a boy wasting money, and I intend for them to.
ledger.9: My uncle keeps the house, the furniture and the accounts that were my father's. He called me nephew four times in one conversation, which is three more than necessary.
ledger.10: My aunt serves tea and an itemised grievance with it. She has decided we are a debt the household is carrying. I let her believe the debt will never be called in.
ledger.11: Fang Zheng asked whether I was angry about the grades. He meant it kindly. I told him the grades were accurate, which is true and not an answer, and watched him accept it.
ledger.12: Set the wine out on the mountain after dark. Nothing on the first night, nothing on the second. The memory says a wine-loving Gu lives here; it does not say which crevice, and five hundred years is a long time for a crevice to stay the same shape.
ledger.13: Fourth night. A bead of white light came out of the bamboo, drank, and went northeast at a speed I had to spend essence to match. I have seen worse returns on two stones.
ledger.14: The crevice opens into a cave with remains in it. A monk, by the vessels. Dead long enough that the clan has had time to build a different story over the top of him.
ledger.15: An image wall, still running on an exhausted Photo-audio Gu. What it shows does not match what the clan celebrates every spring. I watched it three times to be certain I could repeat it without error.
ledger.16: Noted the entrance traces I left: crushed bamboo at the mouth, a scuffed ledge, one footprint in wet clay. Ordinary, individually. Together they are a direction for anyone who thinks to look.
ledger.17: The worm will not be taken by hand. It is faster than I am and it has no reason to trust a jar twice. Spent two more nights on the problem than I would have liked.
ledger.18: Considered and discarded the clan's methods, all of which require telling the clan. An advantage announced is an advantage surrendered.
ledger.19: Used the Cicada's weight on it, and the resistance went out of the worm like water out of a cracked jar. I now own something no fifteen-year-old on this mountain can explain, and a cave nobody knows I can find. The wall will go dark eventually. I will still know where it is.
ledger.20: The worm raises primeval essence by one small stage while it is fed, and it feeds on wine, and wine costs stones I do not have. The cultivation is free. The appetite is not.
ledger.21: Confirmed what I remembered. It will not raise Rank two essence. Whatever edge this gives me has a ceiling, and the ceiling arrives before the danger does. Plan for that.
ledger.22: Moonblade practice in the courtyard. Three straw targets, and every clean strike empties a measurable part of the sea. Knowing the motion is not the same as owning it.
ledger.23: Second day of drills. The elder corrects my stance. It is the stance of a swordsman five centuries dead, so I let him correct it. A boy who already knows everything is a boy somebody looks into.
ledger.24: Third day. Three strikes placed without stopping to breathe. The number that matters is not the damage. It is how many strikes stand between me and an empty aperture.
ledger.25: Stopped Mo Yan at the academy gate after class and explained what his continued comfort was worth. He paid. Not out of fear of me. Paying was simply cheaper than the conversation.
ledger.26: Second collection. Same gate, same hour. The regularity is the whole of it: he sets the money aside, and a loss a man has set aside is a loss he does not complain about loudly.
ledger.27: Third collection. Two of his friends stayed to watch and then walked off without him, which told him more about where he stands than I did.
ledger.28: Raised the rate. Still inside what his allowance absorbs. What limits extortion is not courage. It is the size of a household's purse.
ledger.29: Counted the week: enough for the worm's wine, and a little over. Counted the witnesses too. Four students can place me at that gate, and one of them writes things down for a living.
ledger.30: Someone on the other side has begun counting. Elder Mo Chen put two questions to me in the corridor. Both answerable. Neither idle.
ledger.31: He has no evidence. He has a pattern, and the patience to wait for it to finish forming. That is worse than a witness.
ledger.32: The Mo sent word through the academy and not through the clan. They want this settled quietly. Quiet is expensive for them and cheap for me.
ledger.33: Mo Bei came himself and stood in a classroom doorway as though the doorway owed him the room. I stood when he entered. It cost nothing, and it made his entrance smaller.
ledger.34: They sent a servant with a cudgel to the bamboo path at dusk. He expected no resistance. That is the only part of their planning I would call competent.
ledger.35: Dealt with. The decision took longer than the act. I will not set the act down here; this ledger is for costs, and the cost was an evening and one set of livery to account for.
ledger.36: Left on the path: a body that cannot stay there, livery with a household mark on it, and a cart driver who passed the junction four minutes too early. Three problems, three prices.
ledger.37: The village has decided a servant ran off with something. I did not build that story. I only let it stand, which is usually cheaper than building one.
ledger.38: Mo Bei came to terms in a classroom with the elder present. I said very little. The advantage in that room was not strength and it was not leverage. It was being the only man in it who did not care how the conversation looked.
ledger.39: The caravan is in. Strange Gu at bad prices, and a gambling-stone stall that prices uncertainty better than most clans price certainty.
ledger.40: Lost four stones on two shells. The merchant is honest the way a scale is honest. He does not cheat. He simply knows the odds he is selling.
ledger.41: Bought a Mudskin Toad Gu, mostly so that everything else I bought would look like an afterthought. Small protection. Its real use is to be the thing I talk about.
ledger.42: Watched the stall long enough to learn which shells the merchant handles gently. A purple-gold shell is sealed, and a sealed shell could have held anything.
ledger.43: Three stones for the fossil. From today the Liquor worm came out of a gambling stone at a travelling market, in front of witnesses. The story is worth more than the worm's refinement, and it cost less than the wine.
ledger.44: Someone followed me onto the mountain after dark. Jia Jin Sheng, armed, and confident in a way that only makes sense if he has already decided how the evening ends.
ledger.45: Let him follow. A pursuer who believes he is hunting chooses the ground, and a pursuer who chooses the ground can be told which ground to choose.
ledger.46: Took the high path toward the ravine and he came, the way a man comes when he believes he is choosing. The useful thing about arrogance is that it is navigable.
ledger.47: It is done. I will record what it cost rather than what it looked like: essence, most of one evening, and more luck than I intend to need again.
ledger.48: Cleanup. His trail up the mountain, one villager who saw him leave, residue from a Gu I did not use, and a disappearance that will be reported by morning. Cleaned what could be cleaned and priced the rest.
ledger.49: He is a missing clan youth now, which is a category the clan has procedures for. Procedures are slower than suspicion and they leave a record. I would rather be in a record than in a rumour.
ledger.50: Pressed against the aperture wall until the membrane gave. Rank one, middle stage. A small step, taken on schedule, paid for in wine and stones and one evening on the mountain. The road is long, and I have walked it before.
ledger.51: Jia Fu has opened an inquiry. He is grieving and he is formal, and he has arranged the formality to hold the grief up. I came with my fossil and my dates in order.
ledger.52: He asked where the Liquor worm came from. The caravan, the purple-gold shell, the market, the witnesses. All of it true, and none of it the answer.
ledger.53: They brought out a Bamboo Gentleman. It stays green while the speaker tells the truth, and it stayed green. I will not pretend that was my doing.
ledger.54: Second session. The same question in different words, which is what a man asks when the evidence has run out and the certainty has not.
ledger.55: He asked about the night itself. I accounted for the evening in the kind of detail nobody invents and nobody enjoys hearing.
ledger.56: What he has: a missing cousin, a youth who was on the mountain, and an instinct. What he needs is one piece of anything at all. I spent the week making sure the cheapest piece was already gone.
ledger.57: Third session, shorter. The elders are tired of it. An inquiry that cannot produce a finding becomes an expense, and expenses end themselves.
ledger.58: Closed without a finding. I did not win this; I was not convicted, which is a different and more durable outcome.
ledger.59: Jia Fu said, in front of the council, that he intends to send for an investigator. He named Tie Xue Leng. I wrote the name down and left the page where I would see it again.
ledger.60: Went back to the cave and broke the wall. The images were finished with; what was behind them was not history, it was a test, and a test implies someone expected a successor.
ledger.61: Eastern lamps, a passage, and a chamber with a golden Earth Treasury Flower standing in it. The inheritance hands you exactly what the next obstacle asks for. That is either generosity or design, and I have met very little generosity.
ledger.62: Took Little Light Gu from the Gu room while I was still entitled to. It supports the crescent. A star beside the moon, the clan calls it. I call it a wider cut for the same essence.
ledger.63: Second Light. The Moonblade is measurably heavier now and the cost per strike has not moved. That ratio is the only kind of progress worth trusting.
ledger.64: White Boar Gu out of the flower. It raises bodily strength as it is fed, and the strength stays when the feeding stops. A permanent gain for a recurring cost. Rare.
ledger.65: The Wang family hunt this mountain and they keep what they know on a beast skin. Not a treasure. Working notes. Working notes are worth more.
ledger.66: Found where he sleeps between circuits. A cooking fire, two bowls, a portrait. One occupant, and he considers the mountain his.
ledger.67: Took the map. I will write no more than that. The cost was an afternoon and a decision I had already made before I walked up.
ledger.68: Compared it against the copies the clan hands out. The circles on this one have been left off those. Someone has been selling the mountain with pieces removed.
ledger.69: The map separates animal ground from trap lines. A boar trail to the northeast, a hideout I was not meant to find, and two red circles I will not walk into until I know why they are circled.
ledger.70: Hunted the trail. Three boars in four days, and the Gu took its share of each. My arms are heavier than they were at the start of the week.
ledger.71: Boar blood is the cheapest diet I am paying for, and the hunting that makes it also makes meat I can sell. The only Gu I own that pays for itself.
ledger.72: Fed it again. Strength is collecting in a body that was a scholar's body a week ago. The clan will notice eventually. A body is harder to hide than a Gu.
ledger.73: Stopped counting boars and started counting days. Training has a rate, and it is the rate that limits me, not the appetite.
ledger.74: Went back to the hideout with the map in hand. The hidden circles line up with the ground the occupant keeps away from. What a man avoids is his whole history.
ledger.75: A portrait on the wall. Fresh ash in the fire. Boots by the door in a size I have already measured. Wang Da is alive and he is still on this mountain.
ledger.76: Considered finding him. Decided against it. I know the dangerous ground here better than he does, and knowledge that lets you avoid a fight is worth more than a fight you win.
ledger.77: Left the hideout as I found it. If he never learns the map changed hands, the map goes on working for both of us, and only one of us knows it.
ledger.78: The affairs hall has posted a winter roster. Jiao San leads it, and he carries the group's equipment himself. That tells me what kind of leader he is, and what kind of loss he would be.
ledger.79: The boar strength stopped increasing. Reached the ceiling, as remembered, and the passage ahead has a round boulder in it that needed exactly that ceiling. Pushed it up the slope. Jade Skin Gu in the flower behind it: three seconds of guard, three quarters of the damage turned.
ledger.80: Below the passage the cave opens into a stone forest. I could not see the ceiling from the floor. I went back for a light before I went in, and that is the whole lesson of the place.
ledger.81: Jade-eye monkeys. They hide themselves against the pillars and their bodies come apart into stone when they are done. Jade Skin held. Went in twice more, to learn the pillars rather than the monkeys.
ledger.82: The year-end examination is posted. My brother will be in it, funded, equipped and genuinely talented. The clan has already decided what the result will mean.
ledger.83: Watched him train three afternoons. He layers his defences, and he changes them in the same order every time, because nobody has ever forced him to improvise.
ledger.84: Wrote the order down. Shield, then the second shield, then the step back. A sequence is not a defence. It is a timetable, and a timetable can be met early.
ledger.85: First exchange. He opened exactly as written, in the order I copied down three afternoons ago, and the crowd read it as a strong start for him.
ledger.86: Second phase. Spent essence breaking the layer rather than the boy, and the layer did not come back. A defence that cannot be put up again is a countdown.
ledger.87: Won. He was sincere about the handshake, which was worse for him than losing. The clan moved its opinion of me one notch and its opinion of him not at all.
ledger.88: Accepted a mission, because refusing would have been the remarkable choice. Permafrost, decayed soil, a week in the cold, and the pay will not cover the wine.
ledger.89: Missions are how a clan spends its youths' time so the time cannot be spent on anything else. I have understood the arrangement for five hundred years and I am still inside it.
ledger.90: Gathered the soil. Jiao San apologises when he gives an order. Recorded the quantity, the pay, and the four days I will not get back.
ledger.91: Cultivated at Jiang He's place. He is incurious, which is precisely what I am paying for, and he does not ask why a Rank one wants a closed room.
ledger.92: Rank two. Red steel. Nobody saw it and nobody will be told. A concealed advancement carries a price I am now paying: every time I fight below my rank, anyone watching closely is given something for nothing.
ledger.93: The crossing went wrong on the second day. A boar king and lightning wolves, against a group organised to dig soil.
ledger.94: Jiao San put himself between the wolves and the youngest of them, and went on doing it until he could not. I record it because it happened, not because it changed anything I did.
ledger.95: Went into the carcass. It was warm, and it was the one place on that field the wolves had no interest in. Survival is frequently undignified, and the dignity is never the part that kills you.
ledger.96: Came out with a snowy tusk and most of my essence. Of the group, a minority walked back down. The clan will hold an inquiry into the loss, because a clan is a thing that holds inquiries.
ledger.97: Filed the family-asset application while the hall was still busy with the inquiry. A request put in during a crisis is a request nobody reads twice.
ledger.98: Elder Bo took the application and said it would be considered. He means it will be considered by men who owe my uncle nothing in particular. Today that is the most I can ask.
ledger.99: Refinement room. White Boar and Jade Skin, with the tusk added to hold the binding. The recipe is not certain, whatever the instructors say.
ledger.100: White Jade Gu. Six seconds of guard and nine tenths of the damage turned. It cost the tusk, eight stones and two days. Without the tusk it would have cost more days and more stones, and I would still have it, because some things on this road are only ever a question of price.
ledger.101: The application came back approved in principle, which is the clan's way of saying the argument has been moved into a room I am allowed to enter. Pulled the asset records myself rather than ask for a summary.
ledger.102: The records are clear and my uncle's position is not. He has been managing property he does not own, and reporting the managing as owning, for six years.
ledger.103: Filed the discrepancy. Not as an accusation. As a clerical question. A clerical question is answered by a clerk, and a clerk's answer becomes a document.
ledger.104: Man Shi carried the record boxes for me because I asked him to, and nobody ever has. He is a head taller than the room and has no idea of it. Useful, and not in the way people assume.
ledger.105: Went looking for men who remember the original arrangement. Three do. Two want money. One wants my uncle embarrassed, which is cheaper.
ledger.106: Paid the two. Recorded the amount, because the point of this ledger is that I never pretend a victory was free.
ledger.107: My aunt came to the tavern to explain to the room that I am ungrateful. She is good at it. I let her finish, and then asked her quietly which year the transfer was recorded in.
ledger.108: She did not know. Neither does he. A household that cannot date its own paperwork loses to a household that can.
ledger.109: The council heard it. My uncle spoke first and spoke too long, which is what a man does when his case is a feeling.
ledger.110: Elder Bo asked for the dates. I gave the dates. There is a particular silence a council makes when the tedious party turns out to be the correct one.
ledger.111: Adjourned for consideration. Consideration means the elders are counting who owes what to whom. Nobody is owed anything by me, and in this instance that works in my favour.
ledger.112: Used the adjournment to settle the two witnesses properly and to leave my uncle entirely alone. A man with nothing to push against looks like a man with nothing.
ledger.113: Found in my favour. The property, the tavern, the leaf terraces and the accounts, transferred on a recorded date nobody can argue with.
ledger.114: My uncle asked whether family means anything to me. I told him it means a recorded transfer date. That is the only form of it that has ever protected anybody in this clan.
ledger.115: Took possession. Fang Zheng was in the room and said he hoped this would let us be brothers again. He believed it. I have stopped finding that useful and begun finding it inconvenient.
ledger.116: Word from the Bai clan reached the village before the Bai did. A clan that keeps its own accounts and settles them late. Someone there holds a grievance against their own house, and a grievance is a handle.
ledger.117: Nine Leaf Vitality Grass. It grows leaves on a cycle, and a leaf restores vitality. The only healing I own and the only income I can predict.
ledger.118: Jiang Ya buys the leaves at five stones and does not ask where the terraces came from. Prices first, pleasantries afterward. My preferred kind of merchant.
ledger.119: Attempted Moonglow. The refinement did not take. Lost the materials and the better part of a week.
ledger.120: Went back over the recipe. The error was not in the recipe. Some refinements fail because refinement is uncertain, and an instructor who tells students otherwise is managing their morale, not teaching them.
ledger.121: Bought the materials again out of leaf income. The failure cost eleven stones and nine days, and it did not cost me Moonlight Gu. That is the only part of the sentence that mattered.
ledger.122: Second attempt. Slower, colder, every measure taken twice, because the first failure was not a fault in the recipe and I had nothing else to change.
ledger.123: Moonglow Gu. Rank two, at range, and it replaces the crescent as the thing I actually fight with.
ledger.124: Put the Moonblade back to practice. Kept feeding Moonlight Gu regardless. A Gu you stop feeding is a Gu you no longer own, and I do not give things away on the assumption I will never need them.
ledger.125: The tavern has a wage bill, a supplier, a loss on the stock and a landlord, and from this month the landlord is me. The arithmetic is the arithmetic of the aperture: income, upkeep, what is left.
ledger.126: Traded for a Black Boar Gu and kept the strength after the trade went through. Strength that survives the sale of its source is the nearest thing to free money on this mountain.
ledger.127: Man Shi broke a table and then repaired it badly. Put him on the door instead. A troublemaker pointed outward is a fixture.
ledger.128: Four Flavours needs a second Liquor worm. Bought one. So I have spent real money to destroy a Gu I paid for, in order to make a Gu that eats more than both of them did.
ledger.129: Three days checking the recipe against two sources before touching the materials. The last failure taught me what nine days cost.
ledger.130: Refined it, and it took. Two sources, three days of checking, and a steadier hand than I had in the spring.
ledger.131: Four Flavours Liquor worm. It raises Rank two essence by a small stage, and it drinks six stones of wine every four days. My income now has one duty, and the duty is feeding a worm.
ledger.132: Bought Stealth Scales off the medicine hall's back shelf. Ordinary wolves lose track of whatever wears it.
ledger.133: And Earth Communication Ear Grass, which marks what is moving through the ground. Together they cost nineteen stones, and they are why I expect to see the spring.
ledger.134: Tested both on the lower slopes. The concealment holds while I walk and fails the moment I fight. Recorded, because that failure is the whole shape of this winter.
ledger.135: The tide is coming. Nobody argues with a season; they argue about the roster, which is how a village spends the last quiet week it will get.
ledger.136: Qing Shu has the forward position. He is old, he is scarred, and he asked for equipment rather than honour, which is how I know he understands the order he was given.
ledger.137: The village is fortifying. I bought water shield stock instead of helping, and the distance between those two acts is the distance between me and Qing Shu.
ledger.138: Water Shield Gu, recorded and stored. White Jade stays equipped. Redundancy is cheap when it is bought before it is needed.
ledger.139: Into the forest. Lightning wolves, and not one kind of them. The small fast ones drive; the heavy ones arrive behind. The pack is a structure, not a crowd.
ledger.140: Concealed, and moved. Two hours of crossing instead of twenty minutes of fighting, and I finished with essence still in hand.
ledger.141: Fought once, because a ravine left me no choice. Spent a third of the sea on four wolves. That exchange is the whole argument for never fighting.
ledger.142: Listened through the soil at the ridge and counted what was behind the first wave. There is no position on this mountain that holds against that number. Qing Shu's included.
ledger.143: Found his position from above. He had arranged it properly: lines, reliefs, a place to fall back to. It was competent, and it was not going to be enough, and both of those were plain from where I stood.
ledger.144: Watched. I will not dress that word up. I was concealed, I had leaves, and I had the essence to go down, and I chose the ridge.
ledger.145: It fell at dusk. He was organising a relief that no longer existed when it stopped. I came down the other side of the ridge and arrived in the village with everybody else. Nothing about that day requires explanation, and nobody has asked for one.
ledger.146: The tally: the forward position gone, the second line holding, a third of the forest burnt. The village will talk about Qing Shu for twenty years, and it will talk about him accurately.
ledger.147: Leaf prices doubled. The wounded need vitality and there is one supply of it on this mountain. I did not raise my price. A man who gouges during a disaster is a man people remember clearly.
ledger.148: The tavern was full every night for a week. Grief drinks. Took the money and said the right things to the right men at the right volume.
ledger.149: Closed the season's accounts. Four hundred and sixty stones, after upkeep. I have never held this much, and I have never been this close to needing to leave.
ledger.150: Met a Yao girl in the forest past the second ridge. Soaked through, frightened, and visibly relieved to see a face from the village. She said my name as though it were good news.
ledger.151: What I needed was in front of me, and it had a name, and it was glad to see me. I am not going to set the rest of it down here. This ledger records cost, and the cost was a person who trusted the wrong face.
ledger.152: Rank three. White silver. Genuine, and anyone may verify it. The clan will examine the result long before it examines the road to it. The site is three things now: a place, an absence, and a last-seen.
ledger.153: The council acknowledged the rank. Chi Lian spoke in favour as though we had an understanding of long standing. We do not, and it is now in both our interests to let that stand.
ledger.154: An elder at fifteen. Every smile in that hall was a real gesture of power, and not one of them was trust. Yao Ji was outside it, asking people about her sister.
ledger.155: An elder may requisition what a student could only look at. Sky Canopy for defence, Thunderwings for distance. Sky Canopy replaces White Jade. Thunderwings is the first thing I have owned that makes leaving a plan rather than a wish.
ledger.156: Went through the clan's Rank three recipes. Most of them tie the holder to clan supply through the diet. Convenient, for the clan.
ledger.157: Chose Blood Moon and refined it without error. A red crescent, with a second strike that lands late. Its diet is blood, and there is blood anywhere there are animals, which is everywhere I am going.
ledger.158: Chi Zhong has inherited the medical administration and is pressing an order his predecessor could not enforce. He is young for the post and he quotes regulations at men who outrank him.
ledger.159: Complied with the order, publicly, at a small cost. A new elder who fights the first requisition is a new elder somebody starts a file on.
ledger.160: Yao Ji has asked the same question, in the same words, for five weeks. The village has begun avoiding her. That helps me and it costs her.
ledger.161: Walked the route back, to see what I had left behind. A path used more than it should be, and two people who can date the afternoon.
ledger.162: Cleaned what could be cleaned. Two stones to a carter with a poor memory, and a better one afterward. The third item cannot be cleaned, only contradicted, and a contradiction needs a second story to lean on.
ledger.163: Built the second story out of three true facts and one arrangement of them. That is the strongest kind, and the kind that survives an investigator.
ledger.164: Added the Chainsaw Golden Centipede. Close range, expensive for every swing. I do not intend to use it, and I intend very much to have it.
ledger.165: Practised with it away from the village. Everything I equip now is chosen for a road and not for a clan.
ledger.166: Priced the upkeep of everything I carry at Rank three. Roughly four times what it was in winter. An elder's standing is a thing that must be fed, daily, like any Gu.
ledger.167: Requisitioned travelling supplies through the medicine hall on a legitimate order. Chi Zhong signed it because the paperwork was correct.
ledger.168: Tusita Flower. Storage, and the reason a departure can be packed in advance with no one ever seeing luggage.
ledger.169: Packed. Long before I will need it. Nobody in this village would believe how many years I have been leaving.
ledger.170: Tie Ruo Nan has arrived. Travelling clothes, a notebook, and the unhurried attention of someone who expects to be lied to and is not offended by it.
ledger.171: She did not open with Yao Le. She opened with Jia Jin Sheng, which means she read the old inquiry before she came, which means she is better than Jia Fu was.
ledger.172: Gave her the fossil account and the dates. She wrote both down and asked me to repeat one detail. I repeated it identically, which is what a true account does, and also what a rehearsed one does.
ledger.173: She is going to walk the places. I have known that since the first inquiry opened, and I have spent two years making the places dull.
ledger.174: She went up the bamboo path. There is a trail there that no longer leads anywhere interesting, and it took four separate afternoons across two years to make that true.
ledger.175: She asked the carter. He told her about a cart, a junction, and nothing else, because that is now all he has.
ledger.176: She asked why a Rank one student's essence readings from two winters ago do not match a Rank two's. Nobody else has asked that question in two years. I had an answer ready, and I did not enjoy using it.
ledger.177: Tie Xue Leng is with her now. He has asked me nothing. He watches, and when he speaks it will be a conclusion and not a question.
ledger.178: She has a theory. It is coherent, it fits most of the evidence, and it is wrong, and it is wrong in a direction she chose herself.
ledger.179: It is wrong because of the two pieces I removed and the one I arranged. Had I left the first of them in place it would be right, and I would be finished.
ledger.180: She put her theory to the council. They accepted it. Jia Fu did not, and Jia Fu has neither standing nor evidence, and has had neither since the day his inquiry closed.
ledger.181: Closed. I have recorded the exact margin by which this did not go the other way, because I intend to remember it as a near miss and not as a talent.
ledger.182: There is something beneath the clan. Not a vault. A purpose. I went down because the alternative was waiting for it to come up.
ledger.183: The chamber is larger than any room on this mountain, and it was not built for the living. Whoever laid out the Gu Yue clan was not laying out a clan.
ledger.184: Took the Heavenly Essence Treasure Lotus. Nothing stopped me. That is the part that concerns me.
ledger.185: The founder is down here, and he has been down here the whole time. The clan has spent three hundred years celebrating a story about a man who is lying under its floor.
ledger.186: Lord Sky Crane has come over the mountain out of Central Continent, carrying a grudge older than anyone now standing on it. The clan is furniture to him.
ledger.187: Used the Stone Aperture Gu. Rank three peak inside a quarter of an hour, in a chamber built to make exactly that offer.
ledger.188: It is spent, and with it any chance of anything above this rank. I traded my ceiling for my survival, and I would trade it again, and I am writing it down as a loss because that is what it is.
ledger.189: The blood lake is not a lake. Stood at the edge of it and understood at last what the founder's history had been advertising.
ledger.190: The two of them began, and the scale of it put every fight I have had on this mountain in its proper place. Duels, examinations, wolves. Training.
ledger.191: Kept to the edges. There is no version of that fight in which I am a participant and a version in which I am a survivor. Only one of the two is on offer.
ledger.192: Bai Ning Bing came down into it. I did not arrange that and I did not prevent it. There is a difference between the two, and nobody down there was keeping score.
ledger.193: Fang Zheng was carried off toward Central Continent, unconscious and alive. Alive is the part that will cost somebody later. I record where he went so that I do not forget it.
ledger.194: The curtain went up over the mountain. I will record the decision and not the arithmetic beneath it, because the arithmetic does not improve on a second reading.
ledger.195: It went wrong. Badly, and in a way I had not priced, and that is the first time in two lives I can write that sentence honestly.
ledger.196: Used the Cicada. The second time in two lives, and the last one I have, spent on a mountain I was already finished with.
ledger.197: Spring, then autumn, and a short way backward. Knowing exactly what is coming is not the same as being able to stop it, and the second time through I did not try to stop all of it.
ledger.198: Out across the glacier, with the mountain behind me doing what mountains do when something that old is finished with them. I did not look back, and not for any reason worth recording.
ledger.199: Gave Bai the Yin Gu. The arm is back, and something else is different, and we both watched it happen without discussing it. I kept Yang. That is not an oversight, and Bai knows it is not an oversight.
ledger.200: A raft on the Yellow Dragon River. Rank one, no healing Gu, one companion I control through a Gu I did not give away, and the Southern Border ahead of us. Qing Mao is finished. I have been here before — not this river, but this position — and last time it took five hundred years. I know several things now that I did not know then.

strings.game.intro: Five hundred years of memory. A mountain village. One chance to begin again.
strings.game.blurb: Two hundred chapters of the Qing Mao arc: the rebirth, the awakening, the Liquor worm and the cave, the academy, the inheritance trials, the year-end duel, the winter crossing, the family assets, the wolf tide, the investigation, and the night the mountain came apart. Every chapter is played, staged, or recorded in his own ledger.

strings.notice.heading: Before you begin
strings.notice.body: This story contains violence, cruelty, death and mass death, and many of the people involved are teenagers. Decisions and consequences happen on screen; violence is cut away from, and the aftermath is shown through places and people rather than detail. You can set the intensity now or at any time, and neither setting changes what happens in the story.
